title: Email OSINT Extremely Easy (emailosint.org)
description:
You only need 1 email to map a large part of someone's digital footprint.

emailosint.org runs a reverse lookup that surfaces linked accounts, breach history, and infostealer log exposure in seconds. It requires 0 sign up and can be used by anyone right now.

This is the same kind of recon OSINT investigators and red teamers use before phase one even starts. Believe me when I say that this is a very useful tool.

If your email comes back dirty, that's an attack surface, so be sure to clean up what you can.

For educational purposes only.

top_reply.author: @lukedexter_
top_reply.text: You may be able to use it to find your accounts but not delete them from their original platform. Sites might let you pay to delete them from their site only, which doesn’t matter since the info is still out there in a data breach. You can definitely use it for the use case you’re describing and also improve your security moving forward
